Definition: to have (transitively, exercise; reflexively, get) dominion
BiblicalUsage: 1) to be or act as prince, rule, contend, have power, prevail over, reign, govern; 1a) (Qal) to rule over, govern; 1b) (Hithpael) to lord it over
